name: Question 9
problem:
The inverse of the $3\times 3$ matrix $A$ is found using row operations, as shown below. Complete the process, and determine ${A}^{-1}.$

$$
\begin{aligned}[A\,|\,I\,] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -8 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 0 & \frac{1}{4} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 &  &  &  \\ 0 & 1 & 0 &  &  &  \\ 0 & 0 & 1 &  &  & \end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
